description:
A new family medicine physician, Dr. Sarah Chen, is joining the practice. You need to create her provider user account in LibreHealth EHR.

Log in as the administrator (Username: admin, Password: password).

Navigate to the User management section (Administration > Users) and add a User with the following details:
- Username: schen
- Password: Clinic2024!
- First Name: Sarah
- Last Name: Chen
- Middle Name: L
- Federal Tax ID: 45-2837196
- NPI (National Provider Identifier): 1538246790
- Specialty: Family Practice

CRITICAL SETTINGS:
- Check the 'Authorized' box to mark her as a provider.
- Set the Access Control Group to 'Physicians'.
- Ensure a default facility is selected.

Save the new user account.
